/* selectReqList - Lee MS */
SELECT A.INST_NM AS INST_NM, /* 기관명 */ A.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || A.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_PST_ADDR, /* 주소 */ A.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO, /* 전화번호 */ B.PRTCTN_YNGBGS_TYPE_SE_CD AS PRTCTN_YNGBGS_TYPE_SE_CD, /* 보호청소년유형 */ B.FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD AS FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD, /* 시설유형 */ B.PRTCTN_PSNCPA_CNT AS PRTCTN_PSNCPA_CNT, /* 보호정원 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEB150 T1, SEB100 T2 WHERE T1.PIC_INST_NO = A.INST_NO AND T1.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL ) AS CASE_NOPE /*사례인원 */ FROM SAA000 A, AKA500 B /* 통합기관(C), 센터현황(B) */ WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' AND A.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('5', '8') AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO(+) AND NVL(A.CTPV_CD, ' ') LIKE #{CTPV_CD}||'%'

/* selectSlfrlCntList - Lee MS */
SELECT '00' AS CTPV_CD, /* 시도코드 */ '전국' AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ COUNT(*) AS CTPV_CNT /* 시도숫자 */ FROM SAA000 A WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' AND A.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('5', '8') UNION ALL SELECT B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CTPV_CD, /* 시도코드 */ B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ NVL(A.CTPV_CNT, 0) AS CTPV_CNT /* 시도숫자 */ FROM (SELECT A.CTPV_CD AS CTPV_CD, COUNT(*) AS CTPV_CNT FROM SAA000 A WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' AND A.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('5', '8') GROUP BY A.CTPV_CD ORDER BY A.CTPV_CD) A, (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CTPV_SE_CD' ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE) B WHERE B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.CTPV_CD(+)
